verdict_reason: The new §4 is accurate against the gateway and backend changes, but the summary table, defects and decisions sections still recommend mapping the contact into issuer, and the amendment is undated.

todos.issue: The rewritten §4 (lines 790-794) says the journey no longer collects a contact and issuer is gone from the internal schema and PIMS v0.4.0, but the rest of the doc still says the opposite: line 676 (§6 summary row 4) recommends 'Map the consignment contact the journey already collects into issuer' and says the generic schema requires issuer; line 911 (defect 2) says 'required issuer always absent'; line 923 (decision 4) asks to 'confirm the consignment contact is the right source'; lines 643-646 and 193 describe issuer as still to be filled from the contact/person responsible. The rewrite also replaces §4 in place with no date, while lines 16-20 say §§1-4 stand 'as-of 2026-09-02 plus the dated amendments folded in since' (cf. 'Correction (2026-09-14)' at line 288), so a reader cannot tell §4 is newer than the table and sections that contradict it.
todos.fix: Must: every statement about exchangedDocument.issuer and the consignment contact in the doc agrees with what the EUDPA-776 PR set ships, and the §4 change is marked with its date as the doc's other amendments are. One way: head the new §4 text 'Update (2026-11-20, EUDPA-776):', and add the same dated note to summary row 4 (line 676), defect 2 (line 911), decision 4 (line 923) and the lines 643-646 bullet, saying the contact page and issuer were removed rather than mapped.
